explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/158: for every infinite B₂[2] set A, liminf |A ∩ [0,N)|·N^{-1/2} = 0. B₂[g] (at most g representations n = a + a' with a ≤ a') follows [ESS94]. B₂[2] sets satisfy |A ∩ [1,N]| ≪ √N, so the sequence is bounded and the real liminf is meaningful. The open question is stated affirmatively.
